item.title: Album Review: Kinji — ‘Thunderhead’
item.description: In the same way nature’s counterpart forewarns of dreariness and thunderous disruption, indie musician Kinji’s newest EP Thunderhead starts as the calm before the storm, only to break open, laid bare to the elements, oozing out luscious, melancholic aural landscapes.

item.title: Review: Cedar Rapids Opera’s ‘Die Fledermaus’ is endearing and perfectly ridiculous
item.description: Like a tempting glass of champagne in the middle of Dry January, Cedar Rapids Opera’s production of Johann Strauss’s Die Fledermaus was a perfectly frothy, frivolous escape from the dark and dreary winter.
